description: This file contains step definitions for Cucumber test scenarios related to the dashboard page of the OrangeHRM application, including widget visibility, chart rendering, API response verifications, and role-based UI permissions.

classes.name: DashboardSteps
classes.description: Defines Cucumber step definitions for verifying dashboard page features such as widget visibility, chart rendering, API responses, and role-based permissions.

methods.name: theUserNavigatesToTheDashboard
methods.description: Navigates to the specified dashboard URL path.

methods.name: theDashboardPageShouldLoadSuccessfully
methods.description: Verifies that the dashboard page loads successfully by checking URL and element visibility.

methods.name: theWidgetShouldBeVisible
methods.description: Checks if a widget with the given name is visible on the dashboard.

methods.name: theQuickLaunchWidgetShouldDisplayShortcutIcons
methods.description: Verifies that the Quick Launch widget is visible and shows shortcut icons.

methods.name: eachShortcutShouldHaveAValidNavigationTarget
methods.description: Ensures that each shortcut in the Quick Launch widget has a navigation target.

methods.name: clickingEachShortcutShouldNavigateToTheCorrectPage
methods.description: Sample step to verify that clicking shortcuts navigates correctly (not fully implemented).

methods.name: theChartShouldBeVisible
methods.description: Checks if a specified chart widget is visible, waiting explicitly for canvas elements if necessary.

methods.name: theChartShouldRender
methods.description: Verifies that a chart renders by calling the visibility check.

methods.name: theWidgetShouldDisplayPendingActionCounts
methods.description: Verifies that a widget displays the number of pending actions.

methods.name: theWidgetShouldDisplayTheCurrentDate
methods.description: Verifies that a widget displays the current date.

methods.name: theActionSummaryAPIShouldRespondWith
methods.description: Acknowledges API response verification via widget presence (cannot intercept network in Selenium).

methods.name: theTimeAtWorkAPIShouldRespondWith
methods.description: Acknowledges API response verification via widget presence.

methods.name: theLeaveAPIShouldRespondWith
methods.description: Acknowledges API response verification via widget presence.

methods.name: theSubunitAPIShouldRespondWithValidData
methods.description: Verifies the subunit API responds with valid data via chart rendering.

methods.name: theLocationAPIShouldRespondWithValidData
methods.description: Verifies the location API responds with valid data via chart rendering.

methods.name: theDashboardShouldOnlyDisplayWidgetsPermittedForTheESSRole
methods.description: Confirms the dashboard displays only widgets permitted for the ESS role.

methods.name: adminOnlyWidgetsShouldNotBeVisible
methods.description: Verifies that admin-only widgets are hidden for an ESS user.

methods.name: isWidgetVisible
methods.description: Helper method that waits for and checks the presence of a widget by name on the dashboard.
